facts.text: The Tern ask-user renderer is `TernAskDialog` in `.pi/lib/tern/ask-dialog.ts`. `.pi/lib/tern/bridge.ts` imports it and receives the Pi event bus through its `events` option. The dialog drives the `ask_user_question` remote-ask events documented in `extensions/ask-user/docs/remote-events.md`.

`TernAskDialog` sends a submit or cancel only from user actions: `submit()` and `cancel()` in `.pi/lib/tern/ask-dialog.ts`. `dispose()` also sends a cancel for queued flows that have no request id, so closing the pane cancels pending asks.

Tern's `buildCatalog` in `.pi/lib/tern/commands.ts` combines builtin commands, prompt templates, extension commands, and skills named `skill:<name>` into one catalog. Builtins are marked supported only if listed in `TERN_BUILTINS`.
